children: Tether has confirmed that USDT is now live on the Zama network, where holders can shield it as cUSDT. The integration brings the largest stablecoin to Zama's confidential environment, and five incentive vaults are available from launch.

Shielding USDT into cUSDT lets holders transact in the stablecoin while keeping balances private on Zama. The immediate availability of the vaults gives early users a direct route to deploy the asset rather than wait for later rollout stages. Adoption value for ZAMA depends on how much capital actually moves into shielded USDT, since the catalyst is realized through realized stablecoin flows and sustained network usage rather than the announcement alone. Tether's official confirmation also gives a source-verified reference point for tracking subsequent inflows.

title: Zama: Tether Confirms USDT Live on Zama with Shielded cUSDT - 15 Sep 2026
